The breakfast buffet was delicious, with a lovely Halloween décor adding a festive touch. 
I also loved their fruit tea and coffee — both tasty and reasonably priced. 
The lounge is stylish and comfortable, perfect for relaxing by the pool. 
Special thanks to Tuan, Khanh, Ng Phuong Anh, and Le Phuong Anh for their warm and attentive service!

Great life experience
Oct 2025 • Family
My family recently had a wonderful experience at Bonne Vie Restaurant. We had visited once last time for my birthday, and this time we tried the special Set Menu for Vietnamese Women’s Day. The experience was even more special as the restaurant was beautifully decorated and featured a live piano performance.
The dishes suited my family’s taste very well. I ordered a pizza for my 4-year-old, and even though she had already eaten at home, she still almost finished the whole pizza with great excitement.
I was especially impressed by two staff members, Ms. Linh and Mr. Hieu, who were very attentive and friendly. They even gave my daughter a heart-shaped balloon when we finished our meal and were about to leave.

Thank you for giving our family and all the guests that evening such a delightful night. We’ll definitely be coming back for Christmas, as we’ve heard the decorations are beautiful during that time.

World Class Dining Experience in Haiphong
Dec 2024 • Family
I booked my wedding rehearsal dinner here after reviewing all the restaurants in Haiphong. The menu and decor looked amazing so I figured it would be a good spot.

I had no idea how well the place would be run. This is an absolutely world-class establishment. The staff, especially all-star bartender Tung, stud manager Dien, Nga, Nhi, Phong, and Hoa blew me away with airtight service. 

The chef, Giang, really impressed with skillful execution from start to finish. The smoked duck and the chowder with especially exceptional.

This restaurant is absolutely stunning, and is a must-visit while in the city.
